integrity: Seven standalone UTF-8 files including an executable standard-library verifier are fully embedded with independently computed byte sizes and SHA-256 checksums. Theorems rest on proof, not finite tests.
scientific_limitations: All complete rectangular rook graphs with two factor orders at least two. Excludes one-row cases and higher-dimensional products. Publication priority remains provisional; historical papers may conceal equivalent formulas. Finite checks do not replace proof.
title: Minimal connected domination of rook graphs: a Stirling polynomial and unbounded spectrum gaps
